title: Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker and hero struck down by Heliod who defies death in the Underworld.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: Sun god, envious of his Champion, who struck her down.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: Planeswalker who torments Elspeth in the Underworld.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Returned of Meletis made Heliod's new Champion and Demigod; loved by Elspeth.

entities.name: Shadowspear
entities.description: Weapon Elspeth retrieves from her nightmare.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm of the dead on Theros.

events.summary: Heliod strikes Elspeth down to the Underworld where Ashiok makes her relive her worst moments.
events.quote: struck her down to the Underworld

events.summary: Heliod makes Daxos his new Champion and a Demigod.
Elspeth becomes self-aware and lodges the Shadowspear in Ashiok's chest.
events.quote: lodges it directly in Ashiok's chest

events.summary: Elspeth faces the Nyxborn Agent of Fate, Calix.

relations.quote: having grown envious of his Champion
